## Walkthrough

This pull request updates multiple Tekton pipeline and container configuration files to target a new release version. The changes include: updating four Tekton pipeline YAML files to reference the `release-5.0` branch instead of `release-4.22`, renaming all pipeline identifiers and labels from `mce-217` to `mce-50`, updating output image references accordingly, and switching service account names to match the new version. Additionally, two Containerfile specifications are updated to bump the container image metadata labels from version `4.23` and `multicluster_engine:2.12` to version `5.0` and `multicluster_engine:5.0`, respectively. Total changes across all files: approximately 30 lines.

</details>
